PayPlan | Platform Specialist (Metabase) | Grantham, UK | Remote | 50,000 GBP / year | Full-Time

At PayPlan, we are embarking on a major transformation of our data insight capabilities. We are seeking a Platform Specialist who will act as the Subject Matter Expert in Metabase, leading its rollout and ensuring adoption across the organisation.

This hybrid role offers flexibility, with 2 days in our Grantham office and potential for full remote work after 12 months. Our team is dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of people in debt and provides a supportive work culture with opportunities for personal and professional growth. Join us and be part of a mission-driven organisation that values empathy and respect.

More details and option to apply: https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/PayPlan-Platform-Specialist-Metaba...
